<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Happy Birthday</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#7a1020;--kraft:#c9a574;--kraft2:#b98f5a;--paper:#f6ead0;--red:#a50d1c;
 --w:min(44vw,calc((100dvh - 200px)/1.4097));--h:calc(var(--w)*1.4097);--ease:cubic-bezier(.6,.05,.25,1)}
:root{box-sizing:border-box}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
body{background-color:var(--kraft);
 background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='300' height='300'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.8' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .35  0 0 0 0 .22  0 0 0 0 .08  0 0 0 .22 0'/></filter><rect width='300' height='300' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>"),
 radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#d8b988 0%,#c3996a 60%,#a97d4d 100%);
 font-family:'Caveat','Segoe Print','Bradley Hand',cursive;color:var(--ink);overflow-x:hidden;
 padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
.stage{min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding-top:clamp(28px,7vh,64px)}
.book{position:relative;width:calc(var(--w)*2);height:var(--h);perspective:2600px;transform:translateX(calc(var(--w)*-.5));transition:transform 1.1s var(--ease)}
.book.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.page{position:absolute;top:0;width:var(--w);height:var(--h);overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper)}
img.bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.right{left:var(--w);container-type:inline-size;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(60,35,10,.35);border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.right::after,.back::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:7%;pointer-events:none}
.right::after{left:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(40,20,5,.28),transparent)}
.flip{position:absolute;left:var(--w);top:0;width:var(--w);height:var(--h);transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:left center;transition:transform 1.1s var(--ease);z-index:3}
.book.open .flip{transform:rotateY(-180deg)}
.face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(60,35,10,.35)}
.front{border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;cursor:pointer}
.back{transform:rotateY(180deg);border-radius:3px 0 0 3px}
.back::after{right:0;background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(40,20,5,.28),transparent)}
.book:not(.open) .back{pointer-events:none}.book.open .front{pointer-events:none}
.front:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,.hit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:-3px}
/* letter */
.hit{position:absolute;left:20.5%;top:21.5%;width:29%;height:62%;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:0;padding:0;z-index:2}
.letter{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:84%;z-index:5;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
 transform:translate(-86%,-34%) scale(.42) rotate(-3deg);transition:transform .7s var(--ease),opacity .35s ease;
 box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(40,18,4,.55);border:0;padding:0;background:none}
.letter img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.letter.up{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1) rotate(-1.2deg)}
/* candles */
.flame{position:absolute;transform-origin:50% 97%;will-change:transform,opacity;pointer-events:none}
.flame img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.flame.out{opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s ease}
.smoke{position:absolute;width:6%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(110,95,85,.55),transparent 70%);
 pointer-events:none;animation:rise 1.6s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:.9;transform:translate(0,0) scale(.6)}to{opacity:0;transform:translate(14px,-90px) scale(2.6)}}
.wish{position:absolute;left:50%;top:81%;width:72%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-2deg) scale(.7);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
 text-align:center;background:var(--paper);color:var(--red);padding:3.5cqw 4cqw;font-size:8cqw;line-height:1.05;font-weight:700;
 box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(60,20,10,.4);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1);
 clip-path:polygon(0 4%,6% 0,15% 3%,30% 0,48% 3%,66% 0,82% 3%,94% 0,100% 5%,98% 40%,100% 70%,97% 96%,84% 100%,66% 97%,46% 100%,26% 97%,10% 100%,2% 96%,0 70%,2% 38%)}
.wish.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-2deg) scale(1)}
/* controls */
.dock{margin-top:clamp(16px,3vh,28px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:96px;width:min(96vw,760px)}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 10px;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
button.btn{font:700 20px/1 'Caveat','Segoe Print',cursive;color:var(--paper);background:var(--red);border:0;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;
 box-shadow:0 3px 0 #5e0711,0 6px 12px rgba(40,10,5,.35);touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
button.btn:active,button.btn.on{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #5e0711}
button.btn.alt{background:#2c3e66;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #16213d,0 6px 12px rgba(20,20,40,.35)}
button.btn[hidden]{display:none}
.meter{position:relative;width:120px;height:14px;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(246,234,208,.6);overflow:hidden}
.meter i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a9d6e,#e8b923 60%,#d6381f)}
.meter b{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:30%;width:2px;background:var(--ink);opacity:.7}
.note{font:600 18px/1.2 'Caveat','Segoe Print',cursive;text-align:center;max-width:520px;min-height:22px;margin:0}
.hint{margin:0;font-size:24px;font-weight:700}
.rot{display:none;font-size:17px}
@media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:600px){.rot{display:block}}
canvas#cf{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:50}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.book,.flip,.letter,.wish{transition-duration:.01s}.smoke{animation-duration:.01s}}
</style></head>
<body>
<main class="stage">
 <div class="book" id="book">
  <div class="page right" id="candlePage">
   <img class="bg" alt="Birthday cake with three candles" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
   <div id="flames"></div>
   <div class="wish" id="wish" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="flip">
   <div class="face front" id="cover" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open the birthday card">
    <img class="bg" alt="Cover: teddy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
   </div>
   <div class="face back">
    <img class="bg" alt="Envelope with a letter tucked inside" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
    <button class="hit" id="hit" aria-label="Open the letter"></button>
    <button class="letter" id="letter" aria-label="Tuck the letter back into the envelope"><img alt="Your letter: Happy Boyfriend's Day" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"></button>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
 <div class="dock">
  <p class="hint" id="hint">Tap the cover to open</p>
  <div id="ctrl" hidden style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px">
   <div class="row">
    <button class="btn alt" id="back">Back to cover</button>
    <button class="btn" id="mic">Enable mic</button>
    <div class="meter" title="Mic level" aria-label="Mic level"><i id="lvl"></i><b></b></div>
    <button class="btn" id="hold">Hold to blow</button>
    <button class="btn alt" id="relight" hidden>Relight</button>
   </div>
   <p class="note" id="note">Tap Enable mic, then blow on the candles. Or hold the button or Space.</p>
   <p class="note rot">Tip: turn your phone sideways for bigger pages.</p>
  </div>
 </div>
</main>
<canvas id="cf"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
var NAME='dramebazz';
var FLAMES=[{"l": 25.0, "t": 46.568, "w": 10.242, "h": 10.927, "src": ""}, {"l": 49.113, "t": 45.652, "w": 9.839, "h": 10.984, "src": ""}, {"l": 70.726, "t": 45.709, "w": 10.0, "h": 10.984, "src": ""}];
var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i)};
var book=$('book'),cover=$('cover'),hit=$('hit'),letter=$('letter'),flamesBox=$('flames'),wish=$('wish'),
    hint=$('hint'),ctrl=$('ctrl'),note=$('note'),lvl=$('lvl'),micBtn=$('mic'),holdBtn=$('hold'),relightBtn=$('relight');
var isOpen=false,lit=true,blow=0,blowT=0,holding=false,micOn=false,stream,actx,an,buf,floor=0.01,raf=0,last=0,cfRaf=0;
var flames=FLAMES.map(function(f,i){
  var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='flame';
  d.style.cssText='left:'+f.l+'%;top:'+f.t+'%;width:'+f.w+'%;height:'+f.h+'%';
  d.innerHTML='<img alt="" src="data:image/png;base64,'+f.src+'">';
  flamesBox.appendChild(d);return {el:d,ph:i*1.7,f:f};
});
function say(t){note.textContent=t}
/* open / close */
function openBook(){if(isOpen)return;isOpen=true;book.classList.add('open');hint.hidden=true;ctrl.hidden=false;last=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function closeBook(){if(!isOpen)return;isOpen=false;tuck();book.classList.remove('open');ctrl.hidden=true;hint.hidden=false;stopMic();relight();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);clearConfetti()}
cover.addEventListener('click',openBook);
cover.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();openBook()}});
$('back').addEventListener('click',closeBook);
/* letter */
function lift(){letter.classList.add('up');hit.hidden=true}
function tuck(){letter.classList.remove('up');hit.hidden=false}
hit.addEventListener('click',lift);letter.addEventListener('click',tuck);
/* mic */
function enableMic(){
  if(micOn){stopMic();return}
  if(!window.isSecureContext||!navigator.mediaDevices||!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){say('Mic needs https. Host this file, or use Hold to blow.');return}
  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:false,noiseSuppression:false,autoGainControl:false}}).then(function(s){
    stream=s;actx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();actx.resume();
    var src=actx.createMediaStreamSource(s);an=actx.createAnalyser();an.fftSize=1024;src.connect(an);buf=new Float32Array(an.fftSize);
    micOn=true;micBtn.textContent='Mic on';micBtn.classList.add('on');floor=0.01;calib=performance.now()+400;calSum=0;calN=0;
    say('Mic is listening. Blow on the candles!');
  }).catch(function(){say('Mic blocked. Use Hold to blow or press Space.')});
}
var calib=0,calSum=0,calN=0;
function stopMic(){if(stream){stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop()})}if(actx){try{actx.close()}catch(e){}}stream=actx=an=null;micOn=false;micBtn.textContent='Enable mic';micBtn.classList.remove('on')}
micBtn.addEventListener('click',enableMic);
function micLevel(){
  if(!micOn||!an)return 0;
  an.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf);var s=0;for(var i=0;i<buf.length;i++)s+=buf[i]*buf[i];var rms=Math.sqrt(s/buf.length);
  if(performance.now()<calib){calSum+=rms;calN++;floor=calSum/calN;return 0}
  var th=Math.max(floor*1.6,0.03);return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(rms-th)/0.25));
}
/* hold fallback */
function setHold(v){holding=v;holdBtn.classList.toggle('on',v)}
holdBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){e.preventDefault();holdBtn.setPointerCapture&&holdBtn.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);setHold(true)});
['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'].forEach(function(n){holdBtn.addEventListener(n,function(){setHold(false)})});
holdBtn.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key===' ')e.preventDefault()});
addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.code==='Space'&&isOpen){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setHold(true)}});
addEventListener('keyup',function(e){if(e.code==='Space')setHold(false)});
addEventListener('blur',function(){setHold(false)});
/* main loop */
function loop(t){
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);var dt=Math.min(.05,(t-last)/1000);last=t;
  var target=micLevel();
  if(holding)target=Math.max(target,.8+.15*Math.sin(t/60));
  blow+=(target-blow)*Math.min(1,dt*14);
  lvl.style.width=Math.round(blow*100)+'%';
  if(lit){
    if(blow>.3)blowT+=dt;else blowT=Math.max(0,blowT-dt*2);
    if(blowT>=.5)extinguish();
  }
  var s=t/1000;
  flames.forEach(function(F,i){
    if(F.el.classList.contains('out'))return;
    var sway=Math.sin(s*7+F.ph)*2.2+Math.sin(s*13+F.ph*2)*1.1,b=blow*(1+.12*Math.sin(s*30+i));
    var rot=sway*(1-b)+b*(34+i*3),sk=-b*12,sy=1+.04*Math.sin(s*9+F.ph)-.2*b,sx=1-.12*b;
    F.el.style.transform='rotate('+rot.toFixed(2)+'deg) skewX('+sk.toFixed(2)+'deg) scale('+sx.toFixed(3)+','+sy.toFixed(3)+')';
  });
}
function extinguish(){
  lit=false;
  flames.forEach(function(F,i){setTimeout(function(){
    F.el.classList.add('out');
    var sm=document.createElement('div');sm.className='smoke';
    sm.style.left=(F.f.l+F.f.w/2-3)+'%';sm.style.top=(F.f.t+F.f.h*.45)+'%';flamesBox.appendChild(sm);setTimeout(function(){sm.remove()},1700);
  },i*110)});
  setTimeout(function(){
    wish.textContent='make a wish, '+NAME;wish.classList.add('show');relightBtn.hidden=false;confetti();
    say('Wish made! Tap Relight to try again.');
  },520);
}
function relight(){
  lit=true;blowT=0;wish.classList.remove('show');relightBtn.hidden=true;clearConfetti();
  flames.forEach(function(F){F.el.classList.remove('out');F.el.style.transform=''});
  if(isOpen)say(micOn?'Mic is listening. Blow on the candles!':'Tap Enable mic, then blow. Or hold the button or Space.');
}
relightBtn.addEventListener('click',relight);
/* confetti */
var cv=$('cf'),cx=cv.getContext('2d'),parts=[];
function sizeCv(){var r=window.devicePixelRatio||1;cv.width=innerWidth*r;cv.height=innerHeight*r;cx.setTransform(r,0,0,r,0,0)}
addEventListener('resize',sizeCv);sizeCv();
function confetti(){
  var cols=['#a50d1c','#e8b923','#2fa896','#e86aa5','#2c3e66','#f6ead0'];parts=[];
  for(var i=0;i<170;i++)parts.push({x:Math.random()*innerWidth,y:-20-Math.random()*innerHeight*.5,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*3,vy:2+Math.random()*4,
    w:6+Math.random()*7,h:9+Math.random()*9,r:Math.random()*6,vr:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,c:cols[i%cols.length]});
  cancelAnimationFrame(cfRaf);var t0=performance.now();
  (function step(now){
    cx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);var alive=false;
    parts.forEach(function(p){p.x+=p.vx+Math.sin(p.y/30);p.y+=p.vy;p.r+=p.vr;if(p.y<innerHeight+30)alive=true;
      cx.save();cx.translate(p.x,p.y);cx.rotate(p.r);cx.fillStyle=p.c;cx.fillRect(-p.w/2,-p.h/2,p.w,p.h);cx.restore()});
    if(alive&&now-t0<7000)cfRaf=requestAnimationFrame(step);else cx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);
  })(t0);
}
function clearConfetti(){cancelAnimationFrame(cfRaf);parts=[];cx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight)}
})();
</script>
</body></html>
